title.rendered: Martin Ekman and Daniel Falcone Borg: The River

content.rendered:
Swedish singer-songwriter Marin Ekman and his lifelong friend, bandmate, and multi-instrumentalist Daniel Falcone Borg have been been singing and performing together since they were quite young.

Their ease and comfort with each other shines through in this gorgeous cover of “The River.”

Ekman’s spare, quiet arrangement is appropriately poignant with lovely harmonies, and both singers show an obvious reverence for the source material.

By the dramatic pause that precedes the final chorus, I found myself holding my breath, and I was rapt through the final wistful note.

Bra gjort, gentlemen!

© August 12, 2021

excerpt.rendered: Swedish singers and bandmates Martin Ekman and Daniel Falcone Borg deliver a tender and delicate but powerful cover of Bruce Springsteen’s “The River.”

jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Martin Ekman returns–solo this time–with a wonderful interpretation of "Secret Garden."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Kaiak: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Swedish duo Kaiak gives us a groovy acoustic coffee-house rendition of Bruce's "Hungry Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, The Shining Tongues: State Trooper
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The first cover single from former Infinite Three leader Daniel Knowler, The Shining Tongues' version of "State Trooper" dials up the inner torment and paranoia at the heart of Bruce's song.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Divine Fits: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When Britt Daniel of Spoon and Dan Boeckner of Wolf Parade formed Divine Fits, one of the covers they performed together was Bruce Springsteen's "Hungry Heart." Check it out inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: The Last Time
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Watch Bruce send Giants Stadium off to meet the wrecking ball with an appropriately timed cover of one of The Rolling Stones' earliest hits.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Robin and Linda Williams: My Lucky Day
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: This remarkable folk arrangement of "My Lucky Day" reveals the beauty and tenderness of the song more than Bruce's original arrangement ever did.
